title: Space Launch System Interim Cryogenic Propulsion Stage
used_for: ICPS Artemis I engine variant, propellant and nominal thrust

title: NASA Space Launch System Reference Guide landing page (Artemis I and Artemis II guide access)
source_type: Program reference guide landing page and linked PDFs
used_for: Landing page for NASA SLS reference guide revisions; use S30 for Artemis II-specific prelaunch values and keep revision-specific profiles separate
caveat: Do not treat the landing page as a single fixed revision. SLS reference guide values and ascent profiles vary by mission/revision; the cited preflight profile is not measured telemetry.

title: Artemis I Mission Timeline
used_for: Published Artemis I actual mission elapsed-time launch/ascent events
caveat: Event milestones only; not a continuous altitude/velocity telemetry series.

title: Artemis II Launch Day Updates, 1 April 2026
used_for: Artemis II launch event and ascent milestone time estimates
caveat: NASA explicitly says ascent milestone times may vary by several seconds; store as launch-day estimates, not exact telemetry.

title: Apollo 10 Postflight Trajectory Report - Launch Site Coordinate Reference
source_type: Historical postflight trajectory technical report PDF
used_for: LC-39B historical geodetic coordinates and explicitly stated Fischer 1960 ellipsoid basis
caveat: Historical datum/ellipsoid; transform carefully before mixing with WGS84/ITRF coordinates.

title: Space Launch System Reference Guide for Artemis II (October 2025)
used_for: Artemis II SLS Block 1 prelaunch estimates; core stage propellant and nominal operation; RS-25 and booster thrust; ICPS stage mass; estimated ascent event/time/altitude/speed checkpoints
caveat: NASA states the guide values are approximate prelaunch estimates and may be updated; the ascent profile is a planned/estimated reference, not the executed flight trajectory or raw telemetry.

title: RL10 Engine Fact Sheet (December 2025)
used_for: RL10 variant distinction: RL10B-2 for Artemis I ICPS and RL10C-2 for Artemis II/III reference configurations
caveat: Do not transfer engine-specific values between RL10 variants without checking the applicable engine revision and stage configuration.
